python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect('/home/edbert-chan/.invoker/invoker.db', timeout=20)
c.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=20000")
c.execute("""update tasks
             set runner_kind='worktree', pool_id='local-claude',
                 pool_member_id=NULL, remote_target_id=NULL,
                 execution_agent='claude'
             where is_merge_node=0
               and status in ('pending','queued')
               and pool_id='mixed-local-ssh'""")
c.commit(); print(f"  tasks repointed: {c.total_changes}")
print("\n  routing for everything not yet run:")
for rk,a,p,n in c.execute("""select COALESCE(runner_kind,'-'), COALESCE(execution_agent,'-'),
       COALESCE(pool_id,'(null)'), count(*) from tasks
       where status in ('pending','queued') group by 1,2,3 order by 4 desc"""):
    print(f"    {rk:9s} agent={a:8s} pool={p:24s} {n}")
c.close()
PY
